title: GCB (TV series)
premise_summary: GCB is an American comedy-drama television series developed by Robert Harling, produced by Darren Star, and starring Kristin Chenoweth, Leslie Bibb, Jennifer Aspen, Miriam Shor, Marisol Nichols, and Annie Potts. Airing on ABC, the series was based on the semi-autobiographical 2008 novel Good Christian Bitches by Kim Gatlin. The series centers on a recently widowed and financially ruined woman who moves her family back to the upscale Dallas-area town where she grew up.
